observations: Photo 0 shows the front/side of a black Xbox console with a power/vent area and a warning label; no power cable/adaptor is shown.
Photo 1 shows the console with a black Xbox controller placed on top; the controller has Xbox button layout and colored face buttons, but no model/version text is readable.
No game discs/cases are visible in either photo.
No adaptor/charging brick or power supply is shown, despite the seller mentioning an adaptor issue.

read_from: photo 1 (controller layout indicates Xbox One-era controller; console branding not clearly readable)

claims.claim: Xbox one with one pad for sell
claims.evidence: Photos show an Xbox controller on top of the console (photo 1), but the console model (Xbox One vs One S/One X) and that it is exactly 'one pad' are not fully verifiable from the images.
No game discs/cases or titles are visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
No adaptor/power supply is shown, and there is no photo of the issue (photo 0 and photo 1 only show the console and controller).

risks.risk: Console model/version is unclear (Xbox One vs One S vs One X), which changes value and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/serial/model number sticker (back/bottom) and the exact model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value Xbox One variant with unknown condition.

risks.risk: Adaptor/power supply problem may mean the console may not power on reliably (or at all).
risks.proof: Video clip of the console powering on from the seller’s adaptor (showing the Xbox logo and dashboard) or a photo of the adaptor model + working test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs power fix until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Controller condition (drift, broken buttons, faulty ports) is unknown.
risks.proof: Video showing controller connected and working in-game/menu (button presses + thumbstick movement) or a photo of the controller ports/serial and a quick functional test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller may be faulty (worst case) until tested.

risks.risk: Games may be missing, scratched, or not included as claimed.
risks.proof: Photos of all 6 game discs/cases with titles visible (or a video showing the disc tray and each disc).
risks.if_unproven: Price without the games (worst case) until confirmed.

risks.risk: Console may have other faults not shown (overheating, disc drive issues, HDMI port issues).
risks.proof: Video clip of HDMI output working plus disc drive test (insert a disc and show it loading).
risks.if_unproven: Price as general used console with potential faults (worst case) until tested.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model/serial label (back or bottom) showing exact Xbox One version.
Video of the console powering on using the seller’s adaptor (Xbox logo + dashboard).
Video showing the controller working (menu navigation + thumbstick movement).
Photos of all 6 game discs/cases with titles visible (including the one 'fc').
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox console and an Xbox controller, but the key value drivers (exact model, adaptor issue status, and the 6 games) are not verifiable from the images. With an adaptor issue claimed, you need power-on proof before a reliable price.
